install.title: Add to DuckDuckGo
install.note: Install button on a Chrome Web Store extension detail page, replacing 'Add to Chrome'.

remove.title: Remove from DuckDuckGo
remove.note: Uninstall button on a Chrome Web Store extension detail page, shown when the extension is already installed.

unavailable.title: Unsupported extension
unavailable.note: Label on a disabled button, shown on extensions the DuckDuckGo browser does not support.

unavailableDescription.title: This extension isn't supported. DuckDuckGo is introducing extension support, starting with password managers.
